title: Common providers: Australia
coverage: Complete for the national carriers, the mobile network operators, the largest retail broadband providers, the national wholesale network and the common satellite service; business ISPs and wholesale fibre networks are partial.
missing: Smaller retail providers on the national wholesale network (there are well over a hundred)
Other wholesale fibre networks in new estates
A website for Aussie Broadband (it refused an automated check on the read date)
The regulator's register of licensed carriers (the ACMA site did not answer on the read date)

sources.name: ACMA (Australian Communications and Media Authority): register of licensed carriers
sources.terms: The site did not answer on the read date, so its terms were not read and nothing is taken.
sources.result: Did not answer (no connection). It is the authority to consult for operators this pack lacks.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Internet in Australia and Telecommunications in Australia
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names and ownership (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 8 of 13 names were found on the pages.

sources.name: Each provider's own public website
sources.terms: Only the address itself is recorded (a fact); no content is copied.
sources.result: 12 of 13 websites and 3 business, support or status pages answered an automated check; an address that did not answer is left empty.

sources.name: RIPEstat as-overview (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The RIPEstat service terms were read on the read date; RIPEstat data is not redistributed: nothing is copied. Consulted to confirm, for each AS number, the registered holder and that the number is announced.
sources.result: 21 AS numbers confirmed; a number whose registered holder was another company, or that was not announced on the read date, was left out.

sources.name: NRO delegated statistics (the regional registries' joint list of assigned AS numbers)
sources.terms: Published by the registries for public use; only which registry holds each AS number is taken (a fact).
sources.result: Every AS number in the pack was found in the list; its registry is recorded beside it.

sources.name: Wikidata
sources.terms: CC0 1.0: no conditions. The item id of a provider is recorded as a stable cross-reference.
sources.result: 5 entries carry the id of their own Wikidata item; each item states one of the entry's AS numbers (property P3797). A parent group's item is not used.

sources.name: PeeringDB
sources.terms: The acceptable use policy forbids reproducing PeeringDB data outside approved operational purposes: nothing is copied; cited as a place to look up an AS number.
